title: lollipop counter uses modular arithmetic in linear region
description: _dao_sequence_is_newer (line 116-123 in address_assignment.py) incorrectly uses modular arithmetic (`& 0x7F`) for both linear and circular regions. RFC 6550 Section 7.2 defines two regions: linear (0-127) where sequences should be compared strictly (new > old), and circular (128-255) where modular comparison is correct. Current code: with old=120 and new=5, difference=(5-120)&0x7F=13, returns True. But 5 is not newer than 120 in linear region. This allows stale sequences to be accepted as newer, enabling replay or incorrect retransmission handling during bootstrap.
